what: While the pointer rests on the pill button, letters hop up -20px one by one at 25ms offsets and drop back, repeating every 1s (rise at the first 15%, settle at 30%, cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)), so a wave keeps passing over the button. The arrow nudges 8px and returns .2s late, and the background changes to the accent color over .8s. On touch screens it ripples once (1.38s) when it enters above the bottom 20% of the screen

options.each: Delay between letters (ms), default 25 — original short buttons (three ‹Individual Award›) 140, menu 22
options.lead: Delay in seconds before the arrow trails the text, default .2 (with icon: up, calculated from the character count)
options.start: Spot on the hand screen where the wave runs once (ScrollTrigger start), default top 80%
options.look: plain: Background stays as is, only the text ripples (menu · footer links)
options.--fx-peak: Rise height (via style), default -20px — small button -10px, menu -15px, footer link -14px
options.--fx-dur: Length of one wave (via style), default 1s
options.--fx-hover-bg: Background on hover (via style or css), default --kf-accent
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text lines to split (children). If none, the element’s whole text
options.icon: up: The icon pops up rather than sideways (--fx-icon-peak, default -9px) — the original external link · PDF download button. If lead is not given, about when the last letter drops ((letter count−1)×each + 230ms)

from.where: index.html .sg-btn (black pill ‹Details› button) · top menu .sg-nav__link · footer links — original .btn--hv-bounce · navLinkCharBounce · footerLinkCharBounce · award.html .sg-dl (blue PDF download button, look: plain; icon: up) — original btn-download-char-hover
